note: Radiology NEET-SS lessons (one per module, prep-lessons.js v1 shape). cases = the owner's private case-note ids used as ground (tools/prep-radss-extract.py cases); anat = ground on the module's anatomy notes. Text never enters git; built by tools/prep-radss.mjs lessons.

lessons.title: Congenital heart disease and the great vessels on imaging
lessons.scope: shunt vascularity, chamber enlargement on the chest radiograph, ASD and anomalous venous return, situs and isomerism, vascular rings, aortic dissection and aneurysm, Takayasu arteritis

lessons.title: Cardiac MRI sequences and late gadolinium enhancement
lessons.scope: cine SSFP, T2 oedema imaging, first-pass perfusion, inversion recovery late gadolinium enhancement and inversion time, enhancement patterns: subendocardial, transmural, mid-wall, epicardial, diffuse

lessons.title: Myocardial perfusion and viability with nuclear imaging
lessons.scope: stress and rest perfusion, fixed versus reversible defects, FDG PET viability, perfusion-metabolism mismatch, extent and severity of coronary disease

lessons.title: Vascular disease and its intervention
lessons.scope: Takayasu arteritis and thromboangiitis obliterans on angiography, portal hypertension and TIPS, Budd-Chiari syndrome, percutaneous abscess drainage, image-guided ablation of osteoid osteoma

lessons.title: A reporting approach to bone tumours
lessons.scope: age and site, zone of transition, matrix, periosteal reaction, giant cell tumour, chondroblastoma, chondrosarcoma versus enchondroma, osteosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, myeloma

lessons.title: Metabolic and haematological bone disease
lessons.scope: Paget disease phases and complications, hyperparathyroidism and brown tumours, renal osteodystrophy, sickle cell disease, fibrous dysplasia and Mazabraud syndrome

lessons.title: Joints: necrosis, neuropathy and synovial disease
lessons.scope: avascular necrosis staging, erosive osteoarthritis, neuropathic joint, synovial osteochondromatosis, pigmented villonodular synovitis, posterior shoulder dislocation, tibial eminence avulsion

lessons.title: Skeletal dysplasia and the paediatric hip
lessons.scope: skeletal survey approach, achondroplasia, Morquio syndrome, developmental dysplasia of the hip on ultrasound and radiograph, Hirschsprung disease, neuroblastoma

lessons.title: Focal liver and pancreatic cystic lesions
lessons.scope: haemangioma, focal nodular hyperplasia, hepatocellular adenoma, hepatocellular carcinoma hallmarks, liver abscess, serous cystadenoma, IPMN risk features, pancreas divisum

lessons.title: Gastrointestinal tumours and inflammatory bowel disease
lessons.scope: gastric carcinoma and linitis plastica, GIST, small bowel carcinoid, rectal cancer MRI staging, Crohn disease versus ileocaecal tuberculosis

lessons.title: Peritoneum, mesentery and retroperitoneum
lessons.scope: peritoneal carcinomatosis, mesenteric desmoid and cyst, retroperitoneal lymphoma, IVC leiomyosarcoma, scar endometriosis, perianal fistula classification

lessons.title: Neuro, head and neck and spine anatomy for reporting
lessons.scope: cerebral arteries and veins, cranial nerves and foramina, neck spaces, vertebral column

lessons.title: Chest, abdomen and pelvis anatomy for reporting
lessons.scope: mediastinum and heart, liver segments and bile ducts, bowel, kidneys and adrenals, pelvis

lessons.title: Limbs, breast, obstetric and paediatric anatomy
lessons.scope: joints and limb vessels, breast, obstetric and paediatric normal anatomy

lessons.title: Emergency abdomen and trauma signs
lessons.scope: sigmoid volvulus, large bowel obstruction, hypoperfusion complex after trauma, posterior shoulder dislocation
